notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped creatures, two or which are green.
description:
Cast Ancient Imperiosaur by tapping seven untapped creatures you control, two of which must be green.
Ancient Imperiosaur enters the battlefield with fourteen +1/+1 counters on it.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.
